correctness.rationale: Affine derivative in v is 1; the degree-p valuation at u=infinity has unique Newton slope with p coprime to d-1, proving irreducibility and one totally ramified place. The u=0 reciprocal-v implicit equation gives a second smooth place. Local plane orders (A,B) at infinity and (p,1) at u=0, with gcd(A,B)=1 and p not dividing A, determine the cusp semigroup, distinct tangents, intersection A and Gorenstein conductor. Genus identity checked independently against prior normalization genus; executable exact checker passes.

value.rationale: The ordinary plane model of the newly constructed maximal curves has enormous arithmetic-genus discrepancy, and the theorem determines its complete branchwise gluing at infinity, including the singular local semigroup, contact and conductor orders. Those precise natural embedded invariants are useful for adjunction, normalization and computation of plane-model ideals and are not given by the known smooth genus or point counts. The coefficient-independent general theorem provides structural rather than arbitrary finite information.
